messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm planning to cut release/1.13 from main at 18:00 UTC today. Need final backport asks + any late changelog additions.
anya: thanks! what's the cutoff for cherry-picks? can we still get the telemetry PR in (https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/12843)?
maria: cutoff is 17:30 UTC for code that needs QA. Cherry-picks after that are at risk unless it's a release-blocker. Telemetry PR looks safe if tests pass by 17:15.
cheng: @maria can you confirm the branch name format? we should be consistent for automation.\
maria: release branch name will be release/1.13 — lowercase, no v prefix. That's what our release-bot expects.
release-bot: automatic note: when creating release branches, label the PR with backport/1.13-needed if the change must be applied to the release branch. See docs: https://go.redwood/release-process
Tom: I have a small doc tweak — trivial. Do I need to open a cherry-pick PR or can we update changelog post-cut?\
maria: doc tweaks can be added post-cut to the release branch directly, but if you want it in the release notes now, open a backport PR and tag backport/1.13-needed.
anya: re: backport rules — quick reminder: only bugfixes, regressions, and release-note-critical edits. No new features unless agreed.
cheng: ping @dylan — are there any infra changes that need manual kernel rollouts? I saw PR 12850 touching scheduler config.\
dylan: scheduler config change is a minor default; doesn't require backport. I've flagged it no-backport in the PR. If someone sees perf regressions we can decide later.
maria: for the cherry-pick process: workflow I used last time:
```
# from main
git fetch origin
git checkout -b backport/1.13-pr-<PR>#
git cherry-pick <commit-sha>
# resolve conflicts
git push origin backport/1.13-pr-<PR>#
open PR -> base: release/1.13, title: "[backport 1.13] <original PR title>"
add label: backport/1.13-needed
```
anya: should we require a reviewer other than the original author for backports? avoids subtle merge issues.
maria: yes — at least one reviewer from the area, and please @mention the original PR author for context. CI must be green; flaky test exemptions are rare.
ops-bot: reminder: branch protection will block direct pushes to release/1.13. Use PRs. Required checks: unit, e2e, lint. See: https://go.redwood/branch-protection
Tom: I opened a quick backport PR for the changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/12860 (labelled backport/1.13-needed)\
anya: pushed telemetry fixes to the PR, waiting on tests. @cheng can you review the backport conflict resolution if it shows up?
cheng: yep I'll be on it after standup.
maria: tagging owners for final sign-off: @dylan (infra), @cheng (core), @anya (telemetry). If no objections by 17:25 UTC I'll create release/1.13 and announce the cut.
dylan: LGTM from infra side.
anya: LGTM from telemetry — tests are passing in CI.
cheng: one small nit in the backport, leaving a comment on the PR.
maria: great. after I cut the branch I'll trigger the release-bot flow which will create the release draft and copy changelog entries. If you need hotfixes after cut, open a PR against release/1.13 and add label backport/1.13-needed and mark as release-blocker if urgent.
Tom: thanks — will monitor.
maria: done — release/1.13 created from origin/main at 18:00:05 UTC.
release-bot: release branch created: release/1.13 by maria. Automated tasks started: draft release, backport checklist, CI matrix scheduled.
anya: seeing CI for backport PRs queued.
cheng: I'll finish the review and merge any clean backports now.
maria: last note — if you open a post-cut rollback, mark it with label rollback/1.13 and ping eng-releases. Keep changes small and well-tested.
Tom: ack. thanks everyone :rocket:
